focus_area: ValidateAiSummaryGeneration zero-criteria review guard (SPEC 6.2.1) — guard fires/silences across AiJobCriteria latest-row states, exact message, and ordering vs has_job_description?
scenario: Seeded ai-org-with-candidates (Acme Inc., Rezu May admin, published 'Senior Engineer' job, AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY flipper ON). Called ValidateAiSummaryGeneration.call(job_application:, organization:) directly. Neutralized the two unrelated upstream preconditions (has_resume, ai_credits_available?) via per-call singleton overrides — exactly matching the interactor spec's stubs — so the ONLY variable was the latest AiJobCriteria row state. The guard's own chain (job.zero_criteria_extraction_failure? -> latest_ai_job_criteria -> AiJobCriteria#zero_criteria_failure?) was left fully real. ActiveJob queue_adapter=:test; no OpenAI; no downstream jobs run inline; rows built directly and cleaned via delete_all.
trace: validate_ai_summary_generation.rb:30 (guard) -> job.rb:696 zero_criteria_extraction_failure? -> job.rb:688 latest_ai_job_criteria (ai_job_criteria.order(created_at: :desc).first) -> ai_job_criteria.rb:17 zero_criteria_failure? (status_failed? && ZERO_CRITERIA_ERROR_MESSAGES.include?(error_message)); ordering vs validate_ai_summary_generation.rb:29 has_job_description?
